title: neolitsea mannii
intro: Neolitsea mannii, commonly known as Philippine neolitsea, is a plant species native to the Philippines, belonging to the family Lauraceae. The health benefits of Neolitsea mannii include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, with its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, contributing to its medicinal properties. Bioactive constituents present in Neolitsea mannii include flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, alkaloids like neolitseine, and terpenoids like sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic actions.
